notes: Uses user STEP at scale 1:1; native +Z points toward nozzle, +Y is boss face.
Map native (x,y,z) to (gun_x+x, half_length-z, native_y_lift+y). Length midpoint, not measured mass centre.
Profiles are extracted from STEP and offset by 0.4 mm. Missing physical fillets are not invented.
Open lower saddles end below seam tabs. Upper bridge relief clears those tabs before fitting the upper faces.
Two outboard rear stops leave the middle rear wire path open. Front shoulder stops avoid the barrel.
Camera and shell mounts are not designed by this gun-carrier revision. No powered-operation approval.
